name: H.J. Aldington
features: fair skin, dark hair receding, keen eyes, long face, aquiline nose, medium build, brisk businesslike expression
bio: Known as ‘Aldy’ because he cared for neither of his given names. He took control of AFN in 1929, moved Frazer Nash to Isleworth and drove its chain-gang cars himself in trials and sprints. In 1934 he became BMW’s British agent, which is why the Frazer Nash-BMW 328 exists at all. He ran the firm with his brothers Don and Bill until his son John took over in 1965.
